verdict.rationale: CockroachDB's own docs describe self-hosted clusters, local installation via Homebrew, and starting a single-node cluster, and the source is on GitHub. Community reports add caveats: telemetry is mandatory and even free users need an annual license key. These do not contradict the self-hosting capability. Missing for 10: documented multi-node production self-hosted deployment guidance in the evidence, clarity on the license-key and telemetry requirements for self-hosters.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: CockroachDB self-hosted clusters provide a range of backup and restore features.
A single-node cluster is appropriate for quick SQL testing or app development.
